tasks.label: 1. Run Madara Private Appchain
tasks.command: export LLVM_SYS_190_PREFIX=/usr/lib/llvm-19 && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/lib/llvm-19/bin && cargo run --bin madara --release -j 2 --no-default-features -- --name POCBank --devnet --base-path ../madara_db --chain-config-override=chain_id=PRIVATE_BANK_DEVNET,fee_token_multiplier=0
